component.name: DoDownloadManager
component.summary: Multi-connection download manager with video downloads
Video indirme destekli çok bağlantılı indirme yöneticisi

description.p: DoDownloadManager (DDM) splits downloads into parallel connections, resumes them after restarts and downloads videos with yt-dlp.

ul.li: IDM-style dynamic segmenting with automatic back-off on busy servers
Bonding of several internet connections, such as Wi-Fi and USB tethering
Resuming downloads whose link expired with a fresh link
VirusTotal checks and automatic checksum verification
Rules, archive extraction, scheduler and metered connection handling
Firefox extension that hands browser downloads over to DDM

description.p: DoDownloadManager (DDM) indirmeleri paralel bağlantılara böler, yeniden başlatmalardan sonra kaldığı yerden sürdürür ve yt-dlp ile video indirir.
